narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>Fifteen million years is about fifteen million seconds, near enough.
<bookmark mark='each'/>Each year holds millions of seconds, not one.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>We must multiply the years by the seconds in one year, so the bubble is wrong.
